messages:
Nora P.: Hi team, trying to add my partner to benefits during open enrollment but the portal throws 'Dependent ineligible: DOB mismatch' even though DOB is correct.
Erin (People Ops): Sorry about that Nora. Can you paste the DOB you entered (MM/DD/YYYY) and the partner's legal name?
Nora P.: Entered 04/08/1992, name is Casey R. Nora. It shows 1993 in the preview confirmation step.
Jordan (Benefits): That sounds like a frontend parsing bug where year gets incremented for certain locales. Did you use your browser autofill? Can you try manually typing and not using the date picker?
Nora P.: Tried manual typing and cleared cache. Same issue. Screenshot attached (screenshot-portal-dob.png).
eng-support-bot: New ticket created: TICKET-3721 (open-enroll DOB parsing bug). Notifying @Sam (Platform).
Sam (Platform): Looking now. @Nora can you confirm browser and OS? Also, are you in a different timezone / locale on your machine?
Nora P.: MacOS Sonoma 14.3, Chrome 121. Locale set to en-GB but region US. (I know weird).
Sam (Platform): That helps — reproducing locally with en-GB set. Our date component expects MM/DD but en-GB uses DD/MM. Fix is to lock component to ISO internally. Will patch frontend this afternoon.
Erin (People Ops): For a workaround, @Jordan can manually add your dependent if you email the proof (domestic partnership affidavit + partner DOB) to benefits@redwood.example.com. We'll mark it as an open-enroll addition so payroll picks it up.
Jordan (Benefits): Confirmed. If you send docs we can add it today and update payroll. Please include partner SSN if available.
Nora P.: Sending docs now. Thank you!
people-bot: Life event submitted by Nora P. (Add domestic partner). Ticket #BEN-5019.
Sam (Platform): Patch deployed to staging. Will promote to prod once QA gives thumbs up. ETA 3 hours. :rocket:
